title: Light a dinner candle with a safety match struck on its box, then put the match in the ashtray
instruction: Light the candle in the brass holder with a safety match struck on its box, put the used match in the ashtray and leave the matchbox on the table.
context: Most adults have lit a candle with a match. A safety match lights only when its head is pressed on the striker strip and drawn across it quickly, so the box has to be held in one hand while the other strikes. The flame then has to be brought to the wick and held there for a couple of seconds, and the burning match has to go in the ashtray before the flame creeps down to the fingers. A robot must not do this with bare rubber pads: a real trial fits clip-on shields (0.6 mm 304 stainless over 1.6 mm ceramic fiber, McMaster-Carr 8983K111 and 93285K31) outside the gripping face. A lit match dropped on the table, or a knocked-over candle, is a fire.
setup: Left and right are the robot's. Positions are in metres from the midpoint between the arm bases: x forward, y to the robot's left. A Swan Vestas class matchbox (52 x 36 x 16 mm, 12 g, a striker strip on each long narrow side) lies flat at x 0.27, y 0.17, long side along x. One safety match (47 mm, 2.1 mm splint, red head) lies at x 0.20, y -0.20 along y, head toward -y. A low brass candle holder (91 mm dish, rim 30 mm up, 0.35 kg, free on the table) at x 0.44, y -0.075 holds a 22 x 250 mm dinner candle (80 g, wick tip 263 mm above the table). A round ceramic ashtray (104 mm, 24 mm tall, 0.20 kg, free) stands at x 0.33, y -0.11, in front of the candle holder. For real trials both gripper pads carry the clip-on heat shields described in the context; the shield sits outside the gripping face, so the bare pad still pinches the match 12 mm from its base. Heat is not simulated.
scoring: Four steps, judged from the video. (1, 0.25) The match is struck alight: its head is drawn across the box's striker and a flame is seen at the head. (2, 0.25) The match flame is held at the wick for 0.5 s. (3, 0.25) The candle flame is established and still burns 2 s after the match is drawn away. (4) The used match lies in the ashtray's bowl, the candle is lit, upright and seated, the box is down on the table, no gripper holds or is within 3 cm of the match or box, and neither the match stick, a gripper pad nor a heat shield has touched the candle body, wick or flame (only the match flame may touch the wick, not the wax). Full score 1.0 (ends the run) only once step 4 has held together with step 3 for 1 s, every part within 2 mm and 2 degrees of where it was when that second began; the step points stop at 0.75, also while the second is being timed. The simulator declares ignition when the head is pressed on the strip on two consecutive samples and drawn 15 mm at 0.3 m/s or more; a real trial scores the flame seen on video, never a force reading. The flame burns down the stick at 2 mm/s: if it reaches the pads holding the match or touches a heat shield, the score is capped at 0.5 and 1.0 is lost. Touching the candle body with the match, a pad or a shield caps at 0.5. A lit match on the table outside the ashtray, or a candle tilted more than 15 degrees, scores 0 for the rest of the run.
reset_notes: Lay the box flat at x 0.27, y 0.17; lay the match at x 0.20, y -0.20 along y, head toward -y; stand the candle in the candle holder at x 0.44, y -0.075; put the ashtray at x 0.33, y -0.11. Fit and check the heat shields before the first real trial. Nothing is lit.
fidelity: Match true size, 2 g (real 0.12 g); splint friction 1.2 (PhysX 0.85). Ignition/flames/burn-down (2 mm/s, est.) declared; sim ignition: contact, 15 mm at 0.3 m/s (no force term); pad within 4 mm of flame: scorch. Strip on 4000 N/m panel (real ~3000). Head-strip friction 0.2 (real 0.4 failed). Pinch 12 mm from base (8-11 mm turned out). Candle 250 mm, 80 g; holder rim 30 mm. Heat not simulated; real trials fit 0.6 mm 304 over 1.6 mm ceramic fiber outside the grip. Box matches not modelled.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (580 steps, hit the step limit); demo: 1.0 at step 431 (scripted demo, Isaac Lab-Arena)
